limitations: Building the full Analysis object and cross-reference (XREF) graph is highly memory and CPU intensive, especially on massive APKs like Termux (114MB).
Reflection: If malware invokes Runtime.exec via reflection (java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke), static XREF analysis will fail to link the call graph.
Native Code: If execution is triggered via JNI (C/C++), Dalvik bytecode analysis will not detect the caller.
Obfuscation: Advanced control-flow flattening or dynamic class loading can disrupt the static call chain generation.
